title: [GMCP 203.003.M] Mastery: Modern stateless lifecycle and server discovery
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-003-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: For MCP 2026-07-28 and later GMCP is genuinely stateless at the protocol layer: no initialize ceremony or session identifier is required, every request carries and validates version plus client capabilities, every result identifies the server, server/discover is complete and cacheable, and explicit handles bind all cross-call state. Concurrent requests from changing clients cannot leak negotiated state. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
